The '''Mobile Recon/Research Vehicle''' was a land-based mobile research center commissioned by the [[Science and Culture Administration]] and developed by the [[Hyrotii Corporation/Legends|Hyrotii Corporation]] in the later years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Although sluggish, it was remarkably durable and could navigate almost any terrain. The MR/RV could store two [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]], enabling the crew to perform long-range preliminary patrols. As the Republic gave way to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], MR/RVs fell out of favor because of their civilian-grade armament, particularly in light of the speed and firepower of the [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]], but independent scout teams still found the MR/RV worth the cost of purchase.
